title: 投诉与协商精选 · 36 句
description: 围绕本主题的具体情境组织表达；覆盖请求、说明、比较与复合句，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 我订的是双人间，但安排给我的是单人间。
items.en: I booked a double room, but I was given a single room.
answers: I booked a double room, but I was given a single room.
items.notes: 过去时主动与被动并列，先说明约定，再说明实际收到的服务。

items.zh: 您能在周五之前更换损坏的部件吗？
items.en: Could you replace the damaged part by Friday?
answers: Could you replace the damaged part by Friday?
items.notes: by Friday 表示不晚于周五；replace 指更换，不是 repair 修理。

items.zh: 如果无法按时送达，我希望取消订单并获得退款。
items.en: If delivery by the agreed date is not possible, I'd like to cancel the order and receive a refund.
answers: If delivery by the agreed date is not possible, I'd like to cancel the order and receive a refund.
items.notes: 条件从句明确退款请求的触发条件；cancel 与 receive 并列。

items.zh: 虽然我理解你们很忙，但我已经为同一个问题联系了三次。
items.en: Although I understand you're busy, I've contacted you three times about the same issue.
answers: Although I understand you're busy, I've contacted you three times about the same issue.
Although I understand you are busy, I have contacted you three times about the same issue.
items.notes: although 承认对方情况；现在完成时说明截至目前的联系次数。

items.zh: 让我不满的不是等待本身，而是没有人告诉我发生了什么。
items.en: What frustrates me is not the wait itself but the fact that no one has explained what happened.
answers: What frustrates me is not the wait itself but the fact that no one has explained what happened.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；not ... but ... 聚焦具体不满。

items.zh: 与其再约一次上门，我们能否先通过视频确认故障？
items.en: Rather than arrange another visit, could we identify the fault over a video call first?
answers: Rather than arrange another visit, could we identify the fault over a video call first?
items.notes: rather than + 动词原形；over a video call 表示通过视频通话。

items.zh: 我愿意接受换货，只要新商品没有同样的问题。
items.en: I'm willing to accept a replacement provided that it doesn't have the same fault.
answers: I'm willing to accept a replacement provided that it doesn't have the same fault.
I am willing to accept a replacement provided that it does not have the same fault.
items.notes: be willing to 表示愿意；provided that 提出接受方案的条件。

items.zh: 这笔费用在购买时没有说明，能否请您解释收费依据？
items.en: This fee wasn't disclosed when I made the purchase; could you explain the basis for it?
answers: This fee wasn't disclosed when I made the purchase; could you explain the basis for it?
This fee was not disclosed when I made the purchase; could you explain the basis for it?
items.notes: 被动语态描述未披露事实；basis for 表示依据，分号连接完整分句。

items.zh: 您能把我们刚才商定的退款日期发邮件确认一下吗？
items.en: Could you email me confirmation of the refund date we just agreed on?
answers: Could you email me confirmation of the refund date we just agreed on?
items.notes: we just agreed on 是省略关系代词的定语从句；email 可作及物动词。

items.zh: 如果价格不能再降，是否可以把安装服务包含在内？
items.en: If the price can't be reduced further, could installation be included?
answers: If the price can't be reduced further, could installation be included?
If the price cannot be reduced further, could installation be included?
items.notes: 两处被动语态分别聚焦价格与安装；提出另一种协商空间。

items.zh: 我保留了包装和照片，便于你们核实运输过程中造成的损坏。
items.en: I've kept the packaging and photographs so that you can assess the damage caused during shipping.
answers: I've kept the packaging and photographs so that you can assess the damage caused during shipping.
I have kept the packaging and photographs so that you can assess the damage caused during shipping.
items.notes: so that 表示目的；caused ... 是过去分词定语，修饰 damage。

items.zh: 在接受这个方案之前，我想确认它是否解决了所有未处理的问题。
items.en: Before accepting this proposal, I'd like to check whether it resolves all the outstanding issues.
answers: Before accepting this proposal, I'd like to check whether it resolves all the outstanding issues.
items.notes: before accepting 的逻辑主语为 I；outstanding 在这里表示尚未解决的。

items.zh: 商品描述说有两条电线，但包裹里只有一条。
items.en: The description lists two cables, but the parcel contains only one.
answers: The description lists two cables, but the parcel contains only one.

items.zh: 请核对一下这张账单是否重复收取了配送费。
items.en: Please check whether the delivery fee appears twice on this bill.
answers: Please check whether the delivery fee appears twice on this bill.

items.zh: 维修之后，同样的故障在不到一天内又出现了。
items.en: The same fault returned less than a day after the repair.
answers: The same fault returned less than a day after the repair.
items.notes: less than a day：不到一天。

items.zh: 我不方便再次寄回商品，你们能安排取件吗？
items.en: Sending the item back again is difficult for me; could you arrange collection?
answers: Sending the item back again is difficult for me; could you arrange collection?

items.zh: 如果退款只能退回原卡，请说明那张卡过期后怎么办。
items.en: If the refund must go to the original card, please explain what happens if that card has expired.
answers: If the refund must go to the original card, please explain what happens if that card has expired.
items.notes: 嵌套 if 从句区分两个条件。

items.zh: 我接受新的日期，但需要您确认不会再收取改期费。
items.en: I accept the new date but need confirmation that no further rescheduling fee will be charged.
answers: I accept the new date but need confirmation that no further rescheduling fee will be charged.

items.zh: 你们广告里承诺的功能在这个版本里似乎不可用。
items.en: The feature promised in your advertisement appears to be unavailable in this version.
answers: The feature promised in your advertisement appears to be unavailable in this version.

items.zh: 我想先听听你们如何解释这次延误。
items.en: I would first like to hear your explanation for the delay.
answers: I would first like to hear your explanation for the delay.
I'd first like to hear your explanation for the delay.

items.zh: 这项补偿可以抵扣下次购买，还是能够直接退还现金？
items.en: Can this compensation be used towards a future purchase, or is a cash refund available?
answers: Can this compensation be used towards a future purchase, or is a cash refund available?
items.notes: towards a purchase：用于抵扣购买。

items.zh: 让我们先确认已经达成一致的部分，再讨论剩下的问题。
items.en: Let's confirm what we have agreed on before discussing the remaining issues.
answers: Let's confirm what we have agreed on before discussing the remaining issues.

items.zh: 我愿意调整数量，但单价需要保持不变。
items.en: I am willing to adjust the quantity, provided the unit price stays the same.
answers: I am willing to adjust the quantity, provided the unit price stays the same.
I'm willing to adjust the quantity, provided the unit price stays the same.

items.zh: 如果我们今天付款，您能免除配送费吗？
items.en: Could you waive the delivery charge if we pay today?
answers: Could you waive the delivery charge if we pay today?

items.zh: 这次问题已经影响了活动准备，因此只道歉恐怕不够。
items.en: This issue has affected preparations for the event, so an apology alone may not be enough.
answers: This issue has affected preparations for the event, so an apology alone may not be enough.

items.zh: 请不要在我们确认新方案之前关闭这个工单。
items.en: Please keep this ticket open until we confirm the revised solution.
answers: Please keep this ticket open until we confirm the revised solution.

items.zh: 谁有权限批准超过这个金额的退款？
items.en: Who has authority to approve a refund above this amount?
answers: Who has authority to approve a refund above this amount?

items.zh: 我之前已经提交过这些照片，能否直接使用现有附件？
items.en: I have already submitted these photographs; could you use the existing attachments?
answers: I have already submitted these photographs; could you use the existing attachments?
I've already submitted these photographs; could you use the existing attachments?

items.zh: 我们需要把口头承诺写进修改后的协议。
items.en: We need to include the verbal commitment in the revised agreement.
answers: We need to include the verbal commitment in the revised agreement.

items.zh: 与其把责任归给对方，我更希望先找到问题发生的环节。
items.en: Rather than assign blame, I would prefer to identify where the process went wrong.
answers: Rather than assign blame, I would prefer to identify where the process went wrong.
Rather than assign blame, I'd prefer to identify where the process went wrong.

items.zh: 如果这不是你负责的业务，请把我转给合适的部门。
items.en: If this falls outside your role, please transfer me to the appropriate department.
answers: If this falls outside your role, please transfer me to the appropriate department.

items.zh: 我没有同意更换为价格更高的型号。
items.en: I did not authorise a switch to the more expensive model.
answers: I did not authorise a switch to the more expensive model.
I didn't authorise a switch to the more expensive model.

items.zh: 这项方案解决了费用问题，但没有解决无法使用服务的问题。
items.en: This proposal addresses the cost but not my inability to use the service.
answers: This proposal addresses the cost but not my inability to use the service.

items.zh: 请告诉我下一次进度更新的具体时间。
items.en: Please tell me exactly when I can expect the next progress update.
answers: Please tell me exactly when I can expect the next progress update.

items.zh: 如果部分交付可行，我们可以先接收已经准备好的货物。
items.en: If partial delivery is possible, we can accept the goods that are ready.
answers: If partial delivery is possible, we can accept the goods that are ready.

items.zh: 问题解决后，请提供一份包含处理结果的书面记录。
items.en: Once the issue is resolved, please provide a written record of the outcome.
answers: Once the issue is resolved, please provide a written record of the outcome.
